title: Science and Civilisation in China, volume 5 part 1: Paper and Printing
version: Cambridge University Press first edition, printed pp. 201–203 and fig. 1138; two printed pages per source PDF leaf.
lineage: Printed academic translation and a reproduced image of a premodern witness, not an independent examination of the National Library of China exemplar. The image is rearranged into one double-leaf. Tsien calls it the earliest extant edition, but this proposal does not adopt that priority; the earlier 1166 textual ancestor has not been item-level collated. Original page mapping and image fidelity of the critical page were checked.
